# Planview solution areas and product fit (Avantra summary)

## Strategic portfolio management

Strategic portfolio management connects strategy, funding, resource capacity and delivery. In the Planview portfolio this is centred on Planview Portfolios, with Planview PPM Pro positioned for project portfolio management with faster time-to-value.

## Enterprise agile planning

Enterprise agile planning connects team-level agile delivery (Kanban, teams-of-teams) to portfolio planning. Planview AgilePlace provides visual Kanban boards for agile teams. Planview Hub synchronises work with developer tools such as Jira and Azure DevOps.

## Project and work management

Planview AdaptiveWork provides project management, collaborative work management, resource management, time tracking and workflow automation. Planview ProjectPlace provides collaborative work management for teams.

## Digital product development and value streams

Planview Roadmaps supports product roadmapping. Planview Viz provides value stream management and flow metrics, typically with data from delivery tools integrated via Planview Hub.

## Innovation management

Planview IdeaPlace supports crowdsourcing and evaluation of ideas that can feed portfolio demand.
